$comment: Applied output of the cultural-calendar agent for May 2026 — pan-South-Asian Loudoun audience. Rich month: Akshaya Tritiya (auspicious shopping), Buddha Purnima, wedding-season peak, plus the US calendar overlays (Mother's Day, Memorial Day weekend). The active promo this month is the 10% Spring Sale running through May 31 — the highest-priority anchor across all channels.
seasonal_notes: Late spring in Loudoun — stock-up-for-summer cooking starts (mango/aam panna, lassi, kulfi, chaat masala for street-style platters in the backyard). Indian wedding season hits its peak this month and runs through June; bulk spice + gift-basket inquiries spike. School winds down mid-June (LCPS last day), so cooking-at-home volume rises.

hooks.name: Akshaya Tritiya
hooks.significance: Auspicious day for new beginnings — traditionally gold-buying day but more broadly understood as 'whatever you start today multiplies'. Pantry-restock, gift-giving, and stocking the home kitchen are all in-scope for spice shops.

spice-shop: Akshaya Tritiya pantry-restock — refresh the masala dabba on an auspicious day
Fresh-ground sambar masala timed to Tuesday May 19 (the day itself) — fresh on the auspicious day
Pre-built gift baskets for households starting a new kitchen — wedding gifts, housewarming, college send-offs

do_not_say: an auspicious occasion for the whole family

hooks.name: Buddha Purnima
hooks.significance: Buddha's birth, enlightenment, and death observed on the same full-moon day. Light hook for a pan-South-Asian spice shop — acknowledge without leading. Some customers will cook vegetarian / sattvic that day.

spice-shop: Light acknowledgment — wishes to customers observing, no product push
If running a vegetarian-feature angle: turmeric, coconut, jaggery, curry leaves all in-stock

do_not_say: find your inner peace this week

hooks.name: Mother's Day (US)
hooks.significance: Single-day US calendar event. Light angle for a spice shop — not the brunch-and-bouquet category. The honest play is 'make her the chai she actually drinks' — a build-your-own chai-masala bundle, or the cardamom she's been asking about.

spice-shop: Build-your-own chai masala bundle — cardamom + ginger + cinnamon + cloves + peppercorns, gift-wrapped
The cardamom your mom keeps asking you to bring back from the Indian store — Idukki green, whole pods

do_not_say: celebrate the woman who does everything

hooks.name: Indian wedding season peak
hooks.significance: May is peak wedding-season weekends in the diaspora — May–June and Oct–Dec are the two windows. Drives bulk-spice purchases (cooking for guests), gift-basket inquiries (host gifts, return gifts), and large-bag basmati / dal volume.

spice-shop: Bulk masala for cooking-for-guests — 500g and 1kg sizes available on the shelf, more in the back
Wedding gift basket — Idukki cardamom + saffron + Basmati 1121 + hand-ground garam masala, ribbon-wrapped
Hosting tip: pre-grind the biryani masala on Wednesday for the Saturday function — we'll do it for you Tuesday

do_not_say: your big day deserves the best

hooks.name: Memorial Day weekend
hooks.significance: Three-day US weekend, outdoor-grilling peak. Peripheral but real angle for a spice shop: tandoori marinades, garam masala for kebabs, achaari rubs — the desi backyard grill exists and it needs the right spices.

spice-shop: Tandoori spice blend + Kashmiri chili powder for the grill — desi backyard, real fire
Garam masala for the kebab marinade — 2 tbsp + yogurt + ginger-garlic = 45-minute marinade
Memorial Day weekend hours: open all three days at both stores

hooks.name: Stock-up-for-summer (seasonal)
hooks.significance: Seasonal note, not a festival — summer cooking shifts toward cooling preparations. Chaat masala, kala namak, amchur (dry mango), kulfi-making essentials (cardamom, saffron, pistachio), lassi spices (cardamom, rose water).

spice-shop: Summer pantry refresh — chaat masala, kala namak, amchur on the front shelf
Kulfi season starts — saffron, green cardamom, pistachio kernels in the back fridge
Mango achaar mustard + fenugreek + kashmiri chili in-store as the early-mango shipment lands
